SELECT po.purchase_order_id, po.total_value, SUM(pol.ordered_quantity * pol.unit_cost) AS line_value, po.total_value - SUM(pol.ordered_quantity * pol.unit_cost) AS difference FROM logistics.purchase_orders po JOIN logistics.purchase_order_lines pol USING (purchase_order_id) GROUP BY po.purchase_order_id HAVING ABS(po.total_value - SUM(pol.ordered_quantity * pol.unit_cost)) > 100 ORDER BY ABS(po.total_value - SUM(pol.ordered_quantity * pol.unit_cost)) DESC LIMIT 250

WITH velocity AS ( SELECT item_id, SUM(ABS(quantity_delta)) AS moved_units FROM logistics.stock_movements WHERE facility_id = 7 GROUP BY item_id ), classified AS ( SELECT *, NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY moved_units DESC) AS velocity_class FROM velocity ) SELECT velocity_class, COUNT(*) AS items, SUM(moved_units) AS units, AVG(moved_units) AS avg_units FROM classified GROUP BY velocity_class ORDER BY velocity_class

WITH timeline AS ( SELECT shipment_id, event_type, event_time, LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY shipment_id ORDER BY event_time) AS prior_event FROM logistics.tracking_events ) SELECT shipment_id, event_type, event_time, event_time - prior_event AS event_gap FROM timeline WHERE event_type = 'departed' AND event_time - prior_event > INTERVAL '36 hours' ORDER BY event_gap DESC LIMIT 300

WITH balance AS ( SELECT sm.facility_id, sm.item_id, SUM(sm.quantity_delta) AS on_hand FROM logistics.stock_movements sm JOIN logistics.items i USING (item_id) WHERE i.item_class = 'standard' GROUP BY sm.facility_id, sm.item_id ) SELECT facility_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE on_hand < 0) AS negative_items, SUM(on_hand) AS net_units, AVG(on_hand) AS avg_units FROM balance GROUP BY facility_id ORDER BY negative_items DESC

WITH balances AS ( SELECT facility_id, item_id, SUM(quantity_delta) AS on_hand FROM logistics.stock_movements GROUP BY facility_id, item_id ), demand AS ( SELECT facility_id, item_id, -SUM(quantity_delta) FILTER (WHERE quantity_delta < 0)::numeric / 30 AS daily_demand FROM logistics.stock_movements WHERE occurred_at >= timestamptz '2025-12-31 00:00:00+00' - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY facility_id, item_id ) SELECT b.facility_id, b.item_id, b.on_hand, d.daily_demand, b.on_hand / NULLIF(d.daily_demand, 0) AS days_supply FROM balances b JOIN demand d USING (facility_id, item_id) WHERE b.on_hand / NULLIF(d.daily_demand, 0) < 14 ORDER BY days_supply LIMIT 300

SELECT sh.shipment_id, SUM(si.quantity * i.unit_value) AS cargo_value, SUM(si.quantity * i.unit_weight_kg) AS cargo_weight, SUM(si.quantity * i.unit_value) / NULLIF(SUM(si.quantity * i.unit_weight_kg), 0) AS value_per_kg FROM logistics.shipments sh JOIN logistics.shipment_items si USING (shipment_id) JOIN logistics.items i USING (item_id) WHERE i.item_class = 'hazardous' GROUP BY sh.shipment_id ORDER BY value_per_kg DESC LIMIT 250

SELECT c.service_level, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sh.delivered_at - sh.shipped_at) AS p50, percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sh.delivered_at - sh.shipped_at) AS p90, percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sh.delivered_at - sh.shipped_at) AS p99 FROM logistics.shipments sh JOIN logistics.carriers c USING (carrier_id) WHERE c.service_level = 'economy' AND sh.delivered_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.service_level

WITH bounds AS ( SELECT percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY expected_at - ordered_at) AS q1, percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY expected_at - ordered_at) AS q3 FROM logistics.purchase_orders WHERE priority = 'critical' ) SELECT po.purchase_order_id, po.supplier_id, po.expected_at - po.ordered_at AS planned_lead_time FROM logistics.purchase_orders po CROSS JOIN bounds b WHERE po.priority = 'critical' AND po.expected_at - po.ordered_at > b.q3 + 1.5 * (b.q3 - b.q1) ORDER BY planned_lead_time DESC LIMIT 250

SELECT s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name, COUNT(po.purchase_order_id) AS orders, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE po.order_status = 'received' AND sh.delivered_at <= po.expected_at) AS on_time_in_full, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (sh.delivered_at - po.ordered_at)) / 3600) AS lead_hours FROM logistics.suppliers s JOIN logistics.purchase_orders po USING (supplier_id) LEFT JOIN logistics.shipments sh USING (purchase_order_id) WHERE s.country_code = 'BY' GROUP BY s.supplier_id HAVING COUNT(po.purchase_order_id) >= 3 ORDER BY on_time_in_full DESC, lead_hours LIMIT 200

WITH cohort AS ( SELECT shipment_id FROM logistics.shipments WHERE shipped_at >= DATE '2025-06-16' - INTERVAL '90 days' AND shipped_at < DATE '2025-06-16' + INTERVAL '90 days' ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.shipment_id) AS shipments, COUNT(DISTINCT c.shipment_id) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'departed') AS departed, COUNT(DISTINCT c.shipment_id) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'customs') AS customs, COUNT(DISTINCT c.shipment_id) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'exception') AS exceptions, COUNT(DISTINCT c.shipment_id) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'delivered') AS delivered FROM cohort c LEFT JOIN logistics.tracking_events e USING (shipment_id)

WITH daily AS ( SELECT occurred_at::date AS day, SUM(ABS(quantity_delta)) AS moved_units, COUNT(*) AS movements FROM logistics.stock_movements WHERE facility_id = 29 GROUP BY occurred_at::date ) SELECT day, moved_units, movements, SUM(moved_units) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_units, AVG(movements) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_events FROM daily ORDER BY day

SELECT c.carrier_id, c.carrier_name, COUNT(*) AS shipments, AVG(sh.shipping_cost) AS avg_cost, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (sh.delivered_at - sh.shipped_at)) / 3600) AS avg_hours, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sh.delivered_at > sh.promised_at)::numeric / COUNT(*) AS late_rate FROM logistics.carriers c JOIN logistics.shipments sh USING (carrier_id) WHERE sh.shipped_at >= DATE '2023-06-04' - INTERVAL '180 days' AND sh.delivered_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.carrier_id ORDER BY late_rate, avg_cost

SELECT sh.shipment_id, SUM(si.quantity * i.unit_value) AS cargo_value, SUM(si.quantity * i.unit_weight_kg) AS cargo_weight, SUM(si.quantity * i.unit_value) / NULLIF(SUM(si.quantity * i.unit_weight_kg), 0) AS value_per_kg FROM logistics.shipments sh JOIN logistics.shipment_items si USING (shipment_id) JOIN logistics.items i USING (item_id) WHERE i.item_class = 'cold' GROUP BY sh.shipment_id ORDER BY value_per_kg DESC LIMIT 250

SELECT s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name, COUNT(po.purchase_order_id) AS orders, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE po.order_status = 'received' AND sh.delivered_at <= po.expected_at) AS on_time_in_full, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (sh.delivered_at - po.ordered_at)) / 3600) AS lead_hours FROM logistics.suppliers s JOIN logistics.purchase_orders po USING (supplier_id) LEFT JOIN logistics.shipments sh USING (purchase_order_id) WHERE s.country_code = 'DE' GROUP BY s.supplier_id HAVING COUNT(po.purchase_order_id) >= 3 ORDER BY on_time_in_full DESC, lead_hours LIMIT 200

WITH daily AS ( SELECT occurred_at::date AS day, SUM(ABS(quantity_delta)) AS moved_units, COUNT(*) AS movements FROM logistics.stock_movements WHERE facility_id = 16 GROUP BY occurred_at::date ) SELECT day, moved_units, movements, SUM(moved_units) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_units, AVG(movements) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_events FROM daily ORDER BY day

WITH balance AS ( SELECT sm.facility_id, sm.item_id, SUM(sm.quantity_delta) AS on_hand FROM logistics.stock_movements sm JOIN logistics.items i USING (item_id) WHERE i.item_class = 'standard' GROUP BY sm.facility_id, sm.item_id ) SELECT facility_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE on_hand < 0) AS negative_items, SUM(on_hand) AS net_units, AVG(on_hand) AS avg_units FROM balance GROUP BY facility_id ORDER BY negative_items DESC

WITH cohort AS ( SELECT shipment_id FROM logistics.shipments WHERE shipped_at >= DATE '2023-07-02' - INTERVAL '90 days' AND shipped_at < DATE '2023-07-02' + INTERVAL '90 days' ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.shipment_id) AS shipments, COUNT(DISTINCT c.shipment_id) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'departed') AS departed, COUNT(DISTINCT c.shipment_id) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'customs') AS customs, COUNT(DISTINCT c.shipment_id) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'exception') AS exceptions, COUNT(DISTINCT c.shipment_id) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'delivered') AS delivered FROM cohort c LEFT JOIN logistics.tracking_events e USING (shipment_id)

SELECT c.service_level, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sh.delivered_at - sh.shipped_at) AS p50, percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sh.delivered_at - sh.shipped_at) AS p90, percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sh.delivered_at - sh.shipped_at) AS p99 FROM logistics.shipments sh JOIN logistics.carriers c USING (carrier_id) WHERE c.service_level = 'express' AND sh.delivered_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.service_level

WITH bounds AS ( SELECT percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY expected_at - ordered_at) AS q1, percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY expected_at - ordered_at) AS q3 FROM logistics.purchase_orders WHERE priority = 'normal' ) SELECT po.purchase_order_id, po.supplier_id, po.expected_at - po.ordered_at AS planned_lead_time FROM logistics.purchase_orders po CROSS JOIN bounds b WHERE po.priority = 'normal' AND po.expected_at - po.ordered_at > b.q3 + 1.5 * (b.q3 - b.q1) ORDER BY planned_lead_time DESC LIMIT 250

SELECT po.purchase_order_id, po.total_value, SUM(pol.ordered_quantity * pol.unit_cost) AS line_value, po.total_value - SUM(pol.ordered_quantity * pol.unit_cost) AS difference FROM logistics.purchase_orders po JOIN logistics.purchase_order_lines pol USING (purchase_order_id) GROUP BY po.purchase_order_id HAVING ABS(po.total_value - SUM(pol.ordered_quantity * pol.unit_cost)) > 500 ORDER BY ABS(po.total_value - SUM(pol.ordered_quantity * pol.unit_cost)) DESC LIMIT 250
